summary: B005 promotes a description supplied only by one source into the shared branch core, synthesis, and concept gloss. B001 also omits a directly overlapping neighbor while claiming the remaining candidates belong to different semantic areas.

issues.smallest_correction: Define the core as a kind of tree and move the beautiful-appearance and bitter-taste description to a source-specific associated facet supported by lu_018.

issues.evidence_conflict: The common summary presents the beautiful appearance and bitter taste as part of the shared record. In lu_018, Jamhara supplies only 'a kind of tree', whereas the appearance and taste description occurs only in the Sihah portion.
issues.smallest_correction: Limit the shared synthesis to agreement that the expression denotes a kind of tree, and state without implying cross-source agreement that one source additionally describes its appearance and taste.

issues.evidence_conflict: The concept gloss makes beautiful appearance and bitter taste the branch-wide representation even though the evidence attaches those properties only to the Sihah portion of lu_018; the other supplied forms establish only the tree-kind meaning and singular derivations.
issues.smallest_correction: Use a core gloss equivalent to 'a kind of tree' and retain the appearance and taste description only in a source-specific or contextual gloss with appropriately limited applicability.
